inputs.description: Resource group for the spoke VNet (e.g. 'RG-MY-APP-EASTUS2')
Azure region (e.g. 'eastus2'). Leave blank to use hub location.
VNet address space CIDR (e.g. '10.1.0.0/16'). Run 'IPAM: Discover address space' first to find available ranges.
Comma-separated subnets as name:cidr (e.g. 'default:10.1.0.0/24,private-endpoint:10.1.1.0/28'). Leave blank for no subnets.
Create the resource group if it doesn't exist?
Name of the spoke to remove (as registered in .azure-debug-config.json)
Also delete the resource group and all its resources?
Hostname to test DNS resolution for (e.g. 'myapp.azurewebsites.net'). Leave blank for default checks.
Resource group to check for private endpoints (leave blank for hub RG)
